text:
Anika: Heads-up — nightly docs lint flagged a handful of flaky refs: 8 image 404s, 7 orphan anchors, 1 broken gist in a cross-section of runtime/dedicated and onboarding pages. Not critical but easy wins. Who can pick this up during the morning window?

DocsBot: scan-report: id=scan-2403210000; findings=images:8 anchors:7 gists:1; samples: /dedicated/pools#pool-sizing -> anchor #pool-sizing, /onboarding/installer -> image /assets/installer-wire.png (404), /runtime/cache-management -> missing gist gist.github.com/redwood/example.

Tom: I can handle anchors and small header normalizations. I prefer to edit headers to match existing slugs rather than adding redirects. Will open a single PR grouping anchor-only fixes so QA can smoke test quickly.

Rahul: I can rehost the images to our CDN and add the CloudFront metadata. Heads-up: deploy canary runs at 08:00 UTC, so I'd prefer merges after 11:00 UTC to avoid overlap with infra windows.

Anika: 11:15 UTC merge window sounds fine. Tom, when you update headers, can you include a short grep output in the PR so reviewers can see what changed? Example I used: 

```
rg "installer-wire.png|pool-sizing|gist.github.com" content/ -n --hidden || true
```

Tom: Use this quick awk to print H2s that don't match their slugified anchors (preview only): 

```
awk '/^## /{h=$0; getline; print h}' content/*.md | sed -n 's/^## //p' | awk '{print tolower($0)}' | sed -E 's/[^a-z0-9]+/-/g'
```

Maya: small process note — if you add HTML anchor comments, mention them in the PR description and add a short blurb in docs/NOTES.md so the linter team doesn't file follow-ups. I'll do CR after 11:15 UTC; please @me in the PR.

Tom: Plan: open PR 'docs/anchors/240321' with only header/anchor edits for these three files: dedicated/pools.md, runtime/cache-management.md, onboarding/installer.md. Mark WIP until Rahul posts his image rehost diff.

Rahul: Creating branch docs/images/rehost-240321. Checklist I will follow in the PR: update image paths to /cdn.redwood.ai/docs/..., set CORS metadata, add tiny README in the images dir explaining origin, and include a staging preview screenshot. I will not change permalinks.

Anika: Also add one-line entries in docs/CHANGELOG.md (one-liner per file) for audit. If someone prefers a different file, we can use docs/NOTES.md — either is fine but please stay consistent.

DocsBot: follow-up scheduled in 8h. Reply with 'ack' to pause reminders.

Maya: ack — will CR after merges.

Tom: opening PR now, will paste ripgrep and awk outputs in the description. WIP label applied.

Rahul: pushed image branch and linked the diff in Tom's PR comment. I've also attached a staging screenshot link (staging://screens/240321/installer.png).

Anika: great, thanks folks. I'll watch the follow-up report and close the ticket once DocsBot confirms no remaining findings. :sparkles:
